description: `makeAutoObservable(this)` makes fields observable. Components wrapped in `observer` re-render when an observable they read changes.
A getter on an observable class. Cached and recomputed only when its dependencies change; never store derived values as fields.
Methods become actions that batch writes. After an `await`, wrap writes in `runInAction` (or use `flow`).
`proxy(obj)` creates mutable tracked state. `useSnapshot(state)` returns a frozen snapshot and re-renders when accessed properties change.
Read from the snapshot in render, write to the proxy in handlers. Writing to a snapshot throws; reading the proxy in render does not subscribe.
Proxy-only, legacy decorators removed, `observable.ref`-style helpers became named exports (`observableRef`), and `Provider`/`inject` were removed from the React bindings.
